subject: Emotions
title: The Amygdala Hijack
description: A quick, practical guide to The Amygdala Hijack.

hook.text: Someone cuts you off in traffic and you scream before you even think. Your amygdala just hijacked your brain.

buildup.text: Goleman coined 'amygdala hijack': the moment when the emotional brain overrides rational thinking entirely.

discovery.text: The amygdala processes threats in 12 milliseconds. The prefrontal cortex needs 500ms to engage. Emotion wins every time.

twist.text: The 6-second rule helps: it takes 6 seconds for stress chemicals to dissipate. Pausing that long prevents most regrets.

climax.text: Elite performers train this pause: Navy SEALs use box breathing, traders count to ten, diplomats sip water deliberately.

punchline.text: Between trigger and response, there's a gap. EQ lives in that gap.

quiz.question: How long does the amygdala take to process a threat?
